meta.name: explore
meta.description: Meta-skill for internal codebase exploration at varying depths (quick/deep/architecture)

copy.tagline: 按不同深度探索内部代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速或深入理解代码库结构
copy.tagline_en: Explore internal codebase at varying depths
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly or deeply understand a codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过提问引导你选择探索深度（快速/深入/架构），然后自动分析代码库结构、调用关系或架构层次，并生成摘要、文档或交接文件。整个过程只读不修改代码。
howto.when: 当你输入 /explore 命令（可加参数如 quick、deep、architecture）时触发。如果只输入 /explore 不带参数，Claude 会通过一系列问题帮你确定探索方式。

say.note: 快速浏览 auth 相关代码结构。
深入分析整个代码库并生成文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through questions to choose exploration depth (quick/deep/architecture), then automatically analyzes codebase structure, call relationships, or architecture layers, producing summaries, docs, or handoff files. Read-only, no code changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /explore command (with optional arguments like quick, deep, architecture). If no arguments, Claude asks questions to determine the exploration mode.

say_en.note: Quick overview of auth-related code structure.
Deep analysis of entire codebase with documentation output.
Architecture analysis from main entry point, output handoff file.
